mapper.sql: sv.id, sv.user_id, sv.title, sv.cover, sv.content, sv.address, sv.views, sv.status, sv.reject_reason, sv.create_time, sv.update_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM store_visit sv JOIN `user` u ON sv.user_id = u.id
AND sv.status = #{q.status} AND sv.user_id = #{q.userId}
AND sv.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY sv.id DESC

SELECT
FROM store_visit sv JOIN `user` u ON sv.user_id = u.id WHERE sv.status = 1 ORDER BY sv.views DESC, sv.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM store_visit sv JOIN `user` u ON sv.user_id = u.id WHERE sv.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_visit WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_visit (user_id, title, cover, content, address, views, status, reject_reason) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{cover}, #{content}, #{address}, 0, #{status}, #{rejectReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE store_visit SET title = #{title}, cover = #{cover}, content = #{content}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason} WHERE id = #{id}
